name: Bookbound: A Warlock's Tale Act 1
source:
The city of Una has fallen to the enemy. All hope seems lost until a young woman awakens an ancient spirit entity to aid her in her quest. In exchange for magical powers, she signs a contract that might cost her dearly.

[From [url=https://mondlichtgames.itch.io/bookbound-a-warlocks-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Una城已被敌人攻陷，希望似乎尽失，直到一名年轻女子唤醒古老的灵体，助她踏上征途。为了获得魔法力量，她签下了一份代价可能极其沉重的契约。

[来源：[url=https://mondlichtgames.itch.io/bookbound-a-warlocks-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
